reason: This plugin is primarily an agent-workflow orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: it adds composable controls for execution mode, reasoning style, and quality gates, plus a human-reviewed self-evolution loop that proposes persistent rules from session history. Evidence from README and package metadata shows integration with DSH services (including plan-mode and quality review flows), UI command entry points, and plugin-specific storage, with no indication that it edits project files directly.

summaries.zh: dsh-evolve-modes 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，通过界面和命令提供可组合的任务执行、推理策略、质量门禁与人工审核的自进化规则管理，以便配置和复盘 Agent 的工作流。
summaries.en: dsh-evolve-modes is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that provides composable controls for task execution, reasoning strategy, quality checks, and human-reviewed self-evolution rules to configure and review AI agent workflows.

capabilities: Provides UI and command controls to switch agent working mode, reasoning mode, quality review mode, and evolution mode in DeepSeek Harness Web
Invokes quality/acceptance review flows and plan-mode integration as part of task execution workflows
Stores plugin settings and proposed/approved learned instructions in plugin-managed storage for cross-session behavior continuity
Collects user-session evidence and generates human-reviewable self-improvement proposals

reasons.code: README describes user-facing controls for composable agent workflow dimensions (working, reasoning, quality, self-evolution) shown in the input area and via slash commands.
README details a quality-review pipeline that runs independent checks (adversarial/acceptance) and uses DSH plan mode and review flow, indicating workflow orchestration of AI agents.
Package and plugin manifest configure Web platform client injection and DSH runtime dependencies, confirming this is a runtime/orchestration plugin rather than standalone tooling.
Repository metadata and README identify the project as a DeepSeek Harness plugin with global evolution settings and storage-domain persistence.
